_comment_1: This file controls global settings for the PG-Agent workflows.
_comment_2: To change the editor used for interactive feedback, modify 'default_editor'.
_comment_4: 1. 'system_default': (Recommended) Uses your OS's default application for .txt/.cpp files.
_comment_5: 2. 'code --wait': Use this for Visual Studio Code (requires 'code' in your system's PATH).
_comment_6: 3. Any other CLI command for an editor, e.g., 'subl --wait', 'notepad++'.

workflow_parameters._comment: These values control the behavior of the generation and refinement loops.
